APPLIANCE AND HVAC LIMITED WARRANTY CERTIFICATE
Warranty No: HW-DM-2026-004
Property: Damai Residence, Unit 1 (Apartment), Jalan Damai, Keramat, W.P. Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Provider: HomeShield Appliances Malaysia Sdn Bhd

1. WARRANTY COVERAGE PERIOD
1.1 Coverage starts from installation date shown on commissioning report.
1.2 Standard coverage period is 24 months.
1.3 Claims submitted after expiry date are not eligible unless extended warranty is purchased.

2. COVERED COMPONENTS AND LABOR
2.1 Covered components include:
- Refrigerator compressor
- Air-conditioner blower motor
- Washing machine control board
- HVAC indoor unit fan motor
- Thermostat replacement module

2.2 Covered services include diagnostic labor and standard replacement labor.

3. EXCLUSIONS AND VOID CONDITIONS
3.1 Coverage does not include cosmetic damage, misuse, negligence, or unauthorized repair.
3.2 Gas refill, routine filter cleaning, and preventive maintenance are excluded.
3.3 Warranty is void if serial number labels are removed or altered.
3.4 Damage from flood, power surge without surge protection, or pest infestation is excluded.

4. CLAIM REQUIREMENTS
4.1 Claim package must include:
- Purchase invoice copy
- Equipment serial number
- Fault description with date/time of occurrence

4.2 Service request will be acknowledged within 2 business days.
4.3 Provider may inspect site before approving replacement.

5. SERVICE LEVEL TARGETS
5.1 Urban response target: within 48 hours after claim acknowledgement.
5.2 Parts replacement target: within 7 to 14 business days, subject to stock.

6. LIABILITY LIMIT
6.1 Provider liability is limited to repair or like-for-like replacement of covered items.
6.2 Consequential losses (loss of rent, hotel stay, business interruption) are excluded.
